title: antidesma pentandrum
intro: Antidesma pentandrum, commonly known as the Five-stamen Antidesma, is a plant species belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions, including fever and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Antidesma pentandrum include its ability to modulate immune responses, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and exhibit potential neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
